notes.title: Update 2.1, Level Design & Challenge Mode Fixes
notes.notes: Hello runners, this update fixes object placement issues in certain levels and fixes Intel not being collected properly in the challenge mode. Thank you very much to //KC. and Joker for reporting these issues!

notes.title: 2022 Update - New Sprites, Enhancements, Rebalance
notes.notes:
Dear Runners, 

surprise 2022 Update!


 An all new sprite for Flow
 New shiny laser sprites
 New Moving Block sprites
 Map rebalance and enhancements
 Updated Intro tutorial
 Menu enhancements
 Enhanced Gamepad Support
 Enhanced Borderless Fullscreen support
 New Engine Version
 Enhanced support for Windows HDPI Screen settings


A heartfelt thanks to all of you runners. Your support for this game over all those years both here and on mobile has been humbling and this Update is a way for me to express my gratitude. I hope you like the new things and changes, please let me know how you like the new Sprites for Flow, I had a ton of fun diving back into the game playtesting with the new Sprite.

Oh and one more thing: The price for the Steam version now matches the mobile version. Always wanted to see one of your friends have fun running and dying? Gifting Run or Die is now cheaper than ever!

notes.title: Huge Balance Update & Android version
notes.notes:
https://play.google.com/intl/en_us/badges/images/generic/en_badge_web_generic.png

Hello fellow runners! As you might have seen already, Run or Die is available on Android right now and off to a good start!
I have spent quite some time polishing the mobile version so it plays just as well and snappy as the Steam version. In addition to that, I worked on gameplay clarity and quality of life changes and ALL the improvements now make their way to the Steam version as well!

 Changelog 

     Map clarity and balance updates for more than 100 maps
     Tileset color changes - See the important parts of the map easier!
     New color chooser for easier bomb color swapping
     New and fancy choose your Hero dialog
     Better controller support in the menus (Dualshock 4 now fully supported)
     Cross Platform Highscores with the Run or Die Android version (competing with your friends has never been easier! He (or she) is no PC Gamer? 1st: Try to lead him (or her) to the dark side of PC Gaming. If that doesn't work - 2nd: Tell him (or her) about the Android version! 3rd: BEAT HIM (or her))
     Engine updated for a smoother overall experience


I hope you guys have a good time with the updated features and please let me now if the map clarity and balance changes make a difference for you!
As always, if you encounter any bugs or have other feedback, feel free to post in the forums!

Happy running and have an awesome day,
Flow

notes.title: Run or Die Friendship Release and RunOrDieCade Competition Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Runners!

It’s been quite some time...but I’ve been up to something. Well, up to the biggest Run or Die update yet. And More. A huge competition and a small video of me playing Run or Die with a Guitar Hero Guitar. (But I will get to that later). I feel like the game has come a long way since the beginning and that is why this version will be called:

The Run or Die Friendship Release

Thanks to your feedback, Run or Die has been changing bit by bit over the last year and got better and better. With the addition of Continue for Endless Mode, more map changes than I can count to make the maps more intuitive and more fun, Trading Cards and many quality of life improvements and bug fixes, it feels like you guys and I together made Run or Die a better game than I could have ever built on my own. Thank you. And to give something back, this update is a very special one.

So what does the Run or Die Friendship Release have in store for you? I always dreamt that Flows companions, the Doc and Mr Rumples, join her on her quest one day. And now they did!


    The Doc and your favorite catdog Mr Rumples are now playable characters! 
    The Training Maps have been revamped
    The Introduction got a bit easier
    The Challenge Maps have been edited to be more forgiving in some locations
    There is an option now to disable screen flashes
    Several Bugfixes regarding controller support



I hope that you will have a ton of fun running through Alice City with those two. I certainly had while testing!

As a little surprise for you, I’ve searched for my old Guitar Hero Guitar and tried to beat Run or Die with it. Can’t be that hard right?! Over here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t-cUE31xVGM

The RunOrDieCade Competition

 Prizes: 

1st Prize: 	 A custom made Run or Die Arcade Cabinet 
http://i.imgur.com/P29UgsK.jpg

2nd and 3rd Prize:  A Team Flow T-Shirt (Size S, M or L) 
http://i.imgur.com/YsOGk1H.jpg

 Rules: 
Starting this Saturday for one week (30th of January to 6th of February), everybody who makes it into the Top 5 of a Daily Run and stays there until the end of that day (so everybody in the world no matter the timezone has had a chance to play on that day) has a chance to win a prize. If you make it into the Top 5 on two days, you have two chances, if you make it into the Top 5 on three days, you have three chances etc. 
At the end of the week, winners will be decided by a random draw out of all the runners who made it into the Top 5 during the week! The winners will then be verified, announced and contacted.

 Disclaimer: 
Every player (Steam Account) is only allowed to enter the Daily Run once a day. Everybody who enters a Daily Run twice in one day will be disqualified. In case somebody gets disqualified, the 6th place runner will move up! In addition, I have put other measures in place to prevent people from cheating. If I have a suspicion that someone did cheat I will retain the right to disqualify that player without further reasoning. It might sound a bit harsh, but I do not want to run into any troubles and I will only make use of such measures if I really need to.
As this competition should be a fun time for you and for me and I cannot pay for any legal issues: If you decide to take part in this competition, you agree to not take any legal actions against me in any case in whatever way. Members of Team Flow are not allowed to take part in the competition.


I hope that you like the Run or Die Friendship Release and that many of you will participate in the competition! To conclude this announcement,  Run or Die might have a huge discount starting this Saturday so your friends who haven’t got Run or Die yet can join you!

Give the Run or Die Friendship Release a thumbs up if you like it and feel free to comment if you have any questions or other feedback!

That’s all from me today. Have a nice day and keep on running,
Flo

notes.title: Run or Die v1.14 Update - Map rebalancing!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Runners!

in todays Update we fix a few minor bugs and include touched up versions of over 60 (!) maps for the Endless Mode!

The map changes were made with new players in mind who are in the process of getting to know all the skills and might hit a brick wall (literally) right out of the gate. Apart from those changes, we did update some of the later maps as well in parts which we found to be a bit tricky to traverse in some situations!

As always: What do you guys think about v1.14? Please leave us a thumbs up or a comment down below with your thoughts! 


P.S.: We have thoroughly tested this update, but if you encounter any issues, please head over to the forums and let us know!

notes.title: Run or Die v1.13 Update - We all love lasers, right?
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Runners!

First of all: You guys are awesome. We loved seeing more people reach the Lab after the Run,Die,Continue! Update!

With Update v1.13 we are continuing our efforts to make Run or Die more enjoyable and easier to get into for beginners while not taking away the challenge for advanced players.

Biggest part of this Update are Laser Map Balance Changes. We made the learning curve for Laser Maps a lot smoother while keeping the current level of challenge for the later maps! That way new Runners have more time to get accustomed to the laser mechanic. We sure hope that lasers become less scary now and that players slowly start to like (and maybe still hate them just a little bit) them like we do!

In addition, we tweaked some more Endless Maps regarding parts where randomness could potentially cause hard to manage situations.

The last thing we added is a pause in front of important parts in the Introduction so slow readers do have enough time to read before needing to react.

What do you guys think about v1.13? Please leave us a thumbs up or a comment down below with your thoughts! 


P.S.: We have thoroughly tested this update, but if you encounter any issues, please head over to the forums and let us know!

notes.title: Run or Die v1.1 - Run,Die,Continue! (Anti Frustration Update)
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Runners!

Today we'd like to announce Update 1.1 for Run or Die titled Run,Die,Continue!

In this update we added a small, yet essential feature which changes how the Endless Mode in Run or Die can be played.

One of the biggest issues we heard from you was that many people have a hard time getting into the game, especially on Endless Mode. And we listened. With this update, we hope to make Endless Mode easier to learn and much more fun for new players.

We've added Continue. With this function, players can continue their run from the start of the map they died on and thus tackle the obstacle they died on right afterwards and maybe clear it this time! Players will have 3 Continues per run and of course are able to reach the lab with using Continues! (But: Highscores can only be submitted before using the first Continue in a run.)

What do you guys think about Continue? Please leave us a thumbs up or a comment down below with your thoughts!


P.S.: We have thoroughly tested this update, but if you encounter any issues, please head over to the forums and let us know!

notes.title: Map Visibility Changes & a little extra
notes.notes:
In this silent update we made map visibility changes for many Endless Mode maps improving the visibility of vital obstacles and making sure that background parts which looked a bit too much like foreground look as backgroundy as they should.
If you still encounter hard to read parts on a map, please take a screenshot and show them to us and we will keep on improving!


As a little extra, we added a small animation above Flows head if you collect a piece of Intel in the Challenge Mode back into the game!


Thanks to every single one of our runners for playing Run or Die!
